{{Otheruses|Hammerhead}}
{{Quote|The Ithorians are commonly called Hammerheads.''"''<br />''"''Actually, we dislike the name Hammerheads. It seems deprecating to us.''"''<br />''"''My apologies, sir.|Wedge Antillies and Momaw Nadon|<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>}}
'''Hammerhead''' was a common name used in reference to [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], which referred to the shape of their heads. Ithorians themselves found the term to be highly offensive. "Meerian Hammerhead" referred to the Ithorians of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]].
